name: 60174 · St Charles, IL
findings: ZIP 60174 (St Charles) has 144 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60174 (St Charles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60174 (St Charles) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
